issues.detail: The Hebrew says 'וְנָתַן יְהוָה אוֹתָם לְפָנָי' — 'and Yahweh gives them before me' (before me, i.e., Jephthah). The Chinese renders it as '交在你們面前' — 'before you' (plural). This changes the person from first-person singular (me) to second-person plural (you), altering who receives the victory.
